flame_sweep.name: Flame Sweep
flame_sweep.description: A fire-attribute attack. Sweeps the area in front of you with a powerful flame. Enemies struck by the flame are burned and take continuous damage.

flame_haze.name: Flame Haze
flame_haze.description: Surrounds enemies with burning poisonous mist. Single-target 15-hit attack that also inflicts continuous damage for 10 seconds. Forms a Poison Mist cloud at the hit location (or on you if no enemy is struck).

mist_eruption.name: Mist Eruption
mist_eruption.description: Detonates nearby Poison Mists / DoTs on the target for massive poison damage. 10 hits on up to 12 enemies. Final damage scales with the number of continuous damage effects on the target (2 → +20%, 3 → +45%, 4 → +80%, 5+ → +125%). Hitting with 5+ explosions reduces its own cooldown by 2 sec (before other reductions). On hit, resets Flame Haze's cooldown.

meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower
meteor_shower.description: Passive-only in this sim — never self-cast. Every use of a damaging skill rolls once for an extra meteorite (Lv30: 60% chance × 220% × 1 hit, fire). Sources include Flame Sweep / Haze / Mist Eruption / Teleport Mastery plus the main hits of Inferno Aura / Ifrit / Poison Mist; Meteor Shower does not trigger itself. Explosion skills (Mist Eruption) roll once per explosion (= useCount).

burning_magic.name: Burning Magic
burning_magic.description: Archmage FP passive (Master Lv10). While any DoT is active on the target, main-attack final damage +20% (multiplies with other final-damage sources). The Lv10 DoT duration +100% effect is not yet applied in this sim. DoT ticks themselves do not receive this bonus (per the existing 'DoT ignores generic final damage' rule).

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.description: Archmage FP passive (Master Lv10) / toggle. Casting a Fire-attribute skill has a Lv10 50% chance to spawn a wall of fire at the target (excludes Inferno Aura). Each wall lasts 6s and deals damage at 2s/4s/6s (40% × 1 hit, up to 8 enemies). Multiple walls stack independently. Each tick runs through the main-hit pipeline (crit / mastery / defense / ARC / element / Burning Magic) — not a DoT. Ignite itself does not trigger other skills (e.g. Meteor Shower's Final Attack).

inferno_aura.name: Inferno Aura
inferno_aura.description: Toggle aura (default ON). Every 3 sec deals 400% damage × 2 hits to nearby enemies, and applies a 500%/sec DoT for 30 sec (refreshed on each trigger). First trigger occurs at a random time within the first 3 sec of battle.

poison_mist.name: Poison Mist
poison_mist.description: Lv20: Direct hit 270% + DoT 240%/sec for 6 sec; mist field persists for 15 sec. In the sim this skill is derived — automatically spawned whenever Flame Haze hits. Mist Eruption requires an active Poison Mist field to fire.

ifrit.name: Ifrit
ifrit.description: Summon treated as an always-on aura in the sim (summon duration not tracked). Every 3 sec: 150% × 3 hits + 140%/sec DoT for 2 sec (Lv30). First trigger is random within 0-3 sec of battle start. Passive Mastery bonus (+70% at Lv30) is not wired into CP yet.

teleport_mastery.name: Teleport Mastery
teleport_mastery.description: Toggle skill (default ON in sim). Lv10: single hit 272% + DoT 98%/2sec for 20 sec; recast every 15 sec to refresh DoT. First cast at battle start (after Flame Haze / Mist Eruption priority). Stun / KB resistance not modeled.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.description: Grants allies Magic ATT +30 while active.

magic_guard.name: Magic Guard
magic_guard.description: Redirects a portion of HP damage to MP while active.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Movement skill; increases base and max speed.

mana_wave.name: Mana Wave
mana_wave.description: Upward jump with a slow descent option.

flame_orb.name: Flame Orb
flame_orb.description: Fire-attribute orb attack hitting multiple enemies.

poison_breath.name: Poison Breath
poison_breath.description: Poison cloud attack that leaves a DoT on targets.

mp_eater.name: MP Eater
mp_eater.description: Chance to absorb enemy MP on magic attacks.

elemental_drain.name: Elemental Drain
elemental_drain.description: Passive: Final Damage bonus per active DoT stack on the target.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Fire explosion that damages enemies around you.

creeping_toxin.name: Creeping Toxin
creeping_toxin.description: Summons a poison totem that spreads toxic pools, detonatable for extra damage.

elemental_adaptation.name: Elemental Adaptation
elemental_adaptation.description: Fire and poison veil that blocks debuffs while active.

megiddo_flame.name: Megiddo Flame
megiddo_flame.description: Hyper active (Lv 160): spreads blue flame to targets with 700% DoT.

dot_punisher.name: DoT Punisher
dot_punisher.description: V skill: summons flame orbs based on the number of DoT stacks on enemies.

poison_nova.name: Poison Nova
poison_nova.description: Releases a poisonous cloud that spreads in all directions, hitting nearby enemies 12 times plus a 10s DoT (Lv25 500%/600%; Lv30 550%/660%). Spawns 11 clouds; 2s after cast, Mist Eruption can detonate them — after the grace window, 1 cloud decays every 0.3s. Detonation explosion count equals the current cloud count; first 3 at 100% FD, 4th+ at 50% FD. Unaffected by attack reflection. Cooldown 25s.

infernal_venom.name: Infernal Venom
infernal_venom.description: HEXA Origin: ultimate fire/poison fusion attack.

hexa_flame_sweep.name: HEXA Flame Sweep
hexa_flame_sweep.description: HEXA-enhanced Flame Sweep with giant flame and ember explosions.

hexa_mist_eruption.name: HEXA Mist Eruption
hexa_mist_eruption.description: HEXA-enhanced Mist Eruption with additional mechanics.

hexa_meteor_shower.name: HEXA Meteor Shower
hexa_meteor_shower.description: HEXA-enhanced Meteor Shower with higher damage scaling.

dot_punisher_boost.name: DoT Punisher Boost
dot_punisher_boost.description: HEXA enhancement: increases DoT Punisher Final Damage progression.

will_of_the_alliance.name: Will of the Alliance
will_of_the_alliance.description: Increases STR / DEX / INT / LUK and ATT / Magic ATT by a small amount.

empress_blessing.name: Empress's Blessing
empress_blessing.description: ATT & Magic ATT +30 while active. Mutually exclusive with Blessing of the Fairy.

decent_sharp_eyes.name: Decent Sharp Eyes
decent_sharp_eyes.description: Critical Rate +10%, Critical Damage +8% while active.

combat_orders.name: Combat Orders
combat_orders.description: Weapon Mastery +1%, and increases the level of other buff skills by 1 while active.

heros_echo.name: Hero's Echo
heros_echo.description: Increases the Attack Power and Magic ATT of all nearby characters. Max Level 1 / Master Level 1. Lv1: MP Cost 30, Duration 2400 sec, ATT & Magic ATT +4%, Cooldown 300 sec.

maple_warrior.name: Maple Warrior
maple_warrior.description: Increases primary stat by a percentage based on AP. Lv30 = +15%.

sol_janus.name: Sol Janus
sol_janus.description: HEXA shared skill: dual-form (Dawn / Dusk) with EXP bonus.

sol_janus_dusk.name: Sol Janus: Dusk
sol_janus_dusk.description: HEXA shared: passively generates Primal Crystals from attacks.

blessed_maple_goddesses.name: Blessed of the Maple Goddesses
blessed_maple_goddesses.description: Title granting all-stat +20, ATT / MATK +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore Defense +10%, Critical Rate +15%, Buff Duration +15%.

mulung_600y_inner_power.name: One with 600 Years of Inner Power
mulung_600y_inner_power.description: Title granted to the 1st-ranked character of each job in Mu Lung Dojo — all-stat +15, ATT / MATK +9, Max HP / MP +400, Boss Damage +10%.

flame_sweep_reinforce.name: Flame Sweep - Reinforce
flame_sweep_reinforce.desc: Flame Sweep damage +10%. Does not apply to HEXA Flame Sweep ember explosion.

flame_sweep_cripple.name: Flame Sweep - Cripple
flame_sweep_cripple.desc: Flame Sweep DoT damage +20%. Does not apply to HEXA Flame Sweep ember explosion.

flame_sweep_extra_strike.name: Flame Sweep - Extra Strike
flame_sweep_extra_strike.desc: Flame Sweep Number of Attacks +1. Does not apply to HEXA Flame Sweep ember explosion.

mages_teaching.name: Magician's Teaching
mages_teaching.description: 25% chance to trigger on skill use; each stack grants +3% Damage and +3% Ignore Defense, up to 3 stacks (+9% / +9% at max).

fervent_drain.name: Fervent Drain
fervent_drain.description: Passive: +5% Final Damage per DoT active on the target (up to 5 stacks / +25%; different FD sources multiply).

arcane_aim.name: Arcane Aim
arcane_aim.description: Passive: 100% chance on attack to add 1 stack (max 5, refreshed 5s). Each stack grants +8% Damage (up to +40%, added to CP Damage% before basic/boss recompute). The 20% Ignore DEF is already counted on the CP panel.

infinity.name: Infinity
infinity.description: Auto-activated 450ms after battle starts. Grants Final Damage +70% (Lv30) / +71% (Lv31), additively increased by +3% every 5s until the buff ends. Duration 40s (+1s per level); scaled by Buff Duration%. Cooldown 180s (not affected by cooldown reset).

mana_overload.name: Mana Overload
mana_overload.description: Toggle skill modeled as a permanent independent Final Damage multiplier. +7% at Lv25 / +8% at Lv30 (multiplied with other FD sources). Always on in the battle simulator — no duration or cooldown shown.

mist_eruption_core.description: Skill-specific V Matrix — affects Mist Eruption only: +2% final damage per level; at Lv40+, +20% ignore defense (separate row, not added with Hyper ignore).
